When I phoned up the reception to mark on my file that I didn't want him to be my assigned doctor, the operator replied "I don't really know what you want me to do" - as if anybody else is capable of marking that on my file. No idea why receptionist staff for the NHS feel like they can speak to you like utter crap, as though it's not their job to take your call and that you are putting them out by contacting them the only way you're allowed to.

3 months on from the injury I suffered and the trip to the doctors today felt like it was the first time I was visiting anybody about it. The doctor sat with a full written history of what has occurred with this injury and spoke to me as though it happened yesterday, as if nobody has advised me of anything, treated me or given me any
